meta.basis: The ambo is the 'suitable place from which [the Word of God] may be proclaimed', a 'stationary ambo and not simply a movable lectern', from which the readings, the Psalm and the Exsultet are proclaimed; the Lectionary is prepared at it (GIRM 309, 118b). The GIRM sets no material; stone keeps it apart from the wooden dais of the excerpt, Ezra's reading of the Law (Neh 8:4), the ambo's scriptural type, from the First Reading of the Third Sunday in Ordinary Time, Year C.
